description: This file defines the class TbEntityLocalSubsInfo, which manages local websocket subscription information for entities, including adding/removing subscriptions, updating subscription states, and handling pending subscription events.

classes.name: TbEntityLocalSubsInfo
classes.description: Manages local websocket subscription info for a specific entity, including adding/removing subscriptions, updating states, and managing pending events.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a subscription, updates the internal state, and generates appropriate events based on state changes.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a subscription, updates the state, and generates events if the subscription list becomes empty.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes multiple subscriptions and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: clearState
methods.description: Clears specific parts of the subscription state based on subscription type.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the subscription state based on current subscriptions and triggers update events if needed.

methods.name: toEvent
methods.description: Creates a subscription event with a specific lifecycle type.

methods.name: isNf
methods.description: Checks if notifications are enabled in the current subscription state.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no subscriptions.

methods.name: registerPendingSubscription
methods.description: Registers a subscription as pending for a specific event.

methods.name: clearPendingSubscriptions
methods.description: Clears pending subscriptions for a given sequence number.
